headline: Saudi Uranium Reserves: 110 Million Tonnes of Mineral Reserves Discovered in Saudi Arabia; Major Deposits of Uranium and Rare Earth Elements Found Near Medina
summary: Saudi Arabia has reported a large mineral deposit in the Jabal Sa'id area near Medina, with uranium and rare earth elements. The find is reported at 110 million tonnes of mineral reserves.
why: Uranium and rare earths are strategic inputs for nuclear power and high-tech manufacturing, so new reserves can shift long-term supply expectations.
